name: Acquia CMS DAM
description: Provides an Acquia DAM related configuration.
project_description: The purpose of this module is to integrate the Acquia CMS / Acquia Drupal Starter Kit with Acquia DAM (Widen). It is a thin configuration-only glue layer on top of the acquia_dam contrib module: it ships default media view displays for the acquia_dam_image_asset and acquia_dam_video_asset bundles across Acquia CMS image styles, ships Site Studio (Cohesion) content templates and a sync package for rendering DAM assets, and on install rewires Acquia CMS content-type image fields (article, event, page, person, place) so they can reference DAM image assets. It also points the Site Studio image browser at DAM media types. The actual DAM API integration, media source, and authentication are provided by the acquia_dam module.
